profiling.note: Diagnostic profile predates the final 0.0.3269 rerun; paired and all-board results use 0.0.3269. The method was unchanged by the release.

cause: Automatic breakout creation runs before the normal selector-index phase. Each inserted point invalidates selectors, so resolving trace ports repeatedly walks the board. Warm the existing index before the scan and append the points together afterward; prevent duplicate port entries when the index is warmed again.
limits: Four boards exceed the unchanged 600-second render budget, so final output equivalence cannot be asserted for them.
All 15 settled boards retain existing routing errors; this fix improves render time, not routing completion.
All-board matrix wall times are contended observations; performance conclusions use same-machine paired replays.
iCEPi and H616 use base/head/head/base; OrangeCrab is one base/head pair, so small control-board timing differences are not reliable speedup estimates.
Intermediate experimental runs are excluded; only selectedRuns validate the final production patch.
